main_text.p: Calumnia, quæ huic viro,optimo,doctis-simo,& de Ecclesia Catholica bene merito impingitur, impulit me ad hanc Epistolam Eminentiæ vestræ scribendam, ut veritati testimonium debitum perhibeā, &innocentiam à malevolis iniquissimè appetitam, quantum in me est asseram, verum equidem est, nec diffiteor, librum [illegible, ~3 letters]lum cum plurimis aliis & doctoribus & Episcopis se probasse. Sed id factum est, cum primùm Galliæ innotuit, antequam turbines, qvi postea illius causa commoti sunt, in orbe Christiano excitati fuissent; videbat librum ab Episcopo Catholicæ communionis compositum, cujus autor omnes labores suos Ecclesiæ Romanæ emendandos & expungendos humillimé subjiciebat; videbat librum in Belgio á librorum Censoribus examine facto probatum & commendatum, & duplici privilegio Imperatoris & regis Catholici munitum; videbat librum á multis viris doctis in Gallia magni fieri, á nemine tum attentatum.; librum legit, quæstiones varias&populares

page.notes: Black ink blot covers the start of the word at the beginning of the ninth line; only "lum" is visible, so the word is illegible. Some spots and specks on the page are not printed text. Possible misprint "attentatum.;" with the stray full stop kept as printed. The "to impingitur" word break in line 3 looks like a single word on the scan and is copied as seen.
